Anna: FYI — FinSecure just signed the NDA. They want a private deployment + 20ms p99 chat SLA and SOC2 + on-prem connector. Can product/eng/runtime/infra/security weigh in on feasibility and sequencing?

Liam: 20ms p99 for chat at scale is going to be hard without model/infra changes. We can probably hit ~50–80ms with tuning (no batching, cached prefixes). To get to 20ms we need model trimming, int8 + kernel work, and more GPUs.

Carmen: For private deploy we need VPC peering, cert ingestion, and customer network onboarding. ETA ~4 weeks once infra eng is allocated. Also need dedicated GPU reservations if they want firm p99 SLAs.

Drew: Security note — SOC2 gap analysis required and KMS/HSM integration is non-trivial. Add ~3 weeks for audit prep and doc updates.

Anna: Rough sequencing thought: (A) short-term offer: hosted Dedicated pool with tradeoff (50ms GA) so sales can close; (B) parallel work: private on-prem + SOC2 audit to target 20ms later. Need explicit tradeoff decision: do we commit to 20ms now or propose relaxed SLO?

Liam: To hit 20ms we'd need NVLINK topology, kernel optimizations, and ~2x the GPU footprint. Cost multiplier ~3x. Suggest we propose 50ms for GA and a 3-quarter roadmap to 20ms.

Carmen: +1. Also we need to expose a `--private-connector` flag in the installer and publish an ops runbook. Example installer run for customer staging: 
```
deploy --mode=private --reserve=gpu-dedicated --cert=/opt/finsecure/cert.pem
```

Drew: If they insist on on-prem, we must run a pen test and provide an internal threat model doc. Timeline depends on third-party vendor responses.

Anna: Decision needed by EOD Friday so sales can set expectations. Options: (1) accept 50ms GA and start onboarding now; (2) hold for 20ms but push launch by 12+ weeks. Which do we pick?

Liam: Vote: option 1. Start with a staging canary + perf experiments. We can iterate toward 20ms.

Carmen: Option 1 + infra commitment: I can earmark 1 infra engineer for two sprints and open the runbook PR.

Drew: Option 1 with the caveat that SOC2 preflight checklist must be delivered before GA. I'll own the checklist.

deploy-bot: Canary cluster scheduled for 2024-05-03T09:00Z, job #2345 — status pending infra approval.

Anna: Thanks — I'll relay to sales and set customer expectation to 50ms for GA and a roadmap to 20ms. I'll create the kickoff doc and onboarding checklist now.

Liam: I'll draft the perf experiment list and tie each experiment to rollout gates. Posting RFC later today.

Anna: TY all. @Carmen @Drew please add any blockers into the kickoff doc. :thumbsup:
